description: This source file contains the implementation of the TelemetrySenderImpl class, which is a Vertx-Proton based client for sending telemetry data to an Eclipse Hono server via AMQP. It provides methods for creating senders, constructing target addresses, and sending messages with tracing and timeout handling.

classes.name: TelemetrySenderImpl
classes.description: A Vertx-Proton based client implementation for sending telemetry data to an Eclipse Hono server. It manages creating AMQP senders, constructing target addresses based on tenant and device IDs, and sending messages with tracing and timeout support.

methods.name: getTargetAddress
methods.description: Constructs the target AMQP address for uploading telemetry data for a specific tenant and optionally a device.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the constant telemetry endpoint string.

methods.name: getTo
methods.description: Provides the specific target address for a given device ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new TelemetrySenderImpl instance wrapped in a Future, establishing a connection and setting up a sender.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Sends an AMQP message and waits for an outcome, with optional tracing context.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a specific AMQP message, adds message ID, manages send timeout, and logs delivery status.

methods.name: startSpan
methods.description: Starts a new tracing span for forwarding telemetry data.

methods.name: startChildSpan
methods.description: Starts a child tracing span for forwarding telemetry data.
